catalogue/context/pathway/<pathway>.json (the built pathway reference, from tools/build-pathway-reference.py). It holds BOTH axes independently: the {level} axis tierProgression.levels (FHEQ L3-L8; e.g. L4 undergraduate, L7 postgraduate) and the {tier} axis tierProgression.tierStatements (introductory/intermediate/advanced), plus tierProgression.masteryNote and capabilities[] that EACH carry both a tier AND an fheqLevel (statement, qf extracts, competency verbs)
catalogue/context/pathway/<pathway>.json bookGrounding (chapters, and sections with pages + what each teaches) -- the book window for this tier

catalogue/context/subject/benchmarks/universal-reference.json (the generic, subject-neutral shared core distilled across the 54 QAA benchmarks, tools/build-universal-benchmark.py): tierReadings.rows (per-tier practice/knowledge/identity, each with fheqLevel + pitchNote) and pathwayMapping['adapt-<pathway>'] (the shared-core statements mapped to this pathway, each with strength + agentInstruction) -- the standing generic phrase source alongside FHEQ/CQFW, always consulted, never a subject substitute

parameters.present: Use BOTH axes. The {level} axis (FHEQ L3-L8) and the {tier} axis (introductory/intermediate/advanced) generally align -- intro L3/L4, intermediate L4/L5/L6, advanced L5/L6/L7 (design-kb.tier-bands.json indicativeLevels) -- so the tiers OVERLAP at L4 (intro/intermediate) and L5-L6 (intermediate/advanced); surface that blur/crossover rather than hiding it, and keep tiers experience-anchored (not strict credit level: a learner can be advanced in one practice, introductory in another). Lay the three tiers side by side for THIS pathway and book: each tier's cognitive demand (tier-spec D1-D4), its tierStatements and capabilities (each with its own fheqLevel + verbs), and the book sections that carry it (bookGrounding pages + teaches); read through the levels to show where the tiers meet and blur. Consult universal-reference.json (tierReadings + pathwayMapping['adapt-<pathway>']) as the standing generic phrasing for each tier -- subject-neutral, filling where the pathway reference is thin. The human chooses the course tier (pitch); no-tier stays selectable; per-level targeting is a later facet (cxs-01).

Every outcome text (both crs-03_course-outcomes.courseOutcomes[].text and crs-04_lesson-map.lessons[].outcomes[].text) states one verb and one object, never two tasks joined by 'and'. Each lesson's outcome count is a judgement call, not a count derived from lessons[].sourceSections.length. Each lesson outcome's subject matter stays inside crs-02_thematic-scope.sectionsInScope (and does not stray into sectionsOutOfScope) - a qualitative check, not a string match.

layer.description: 1 = one LO per real book-chapter section. 2 = fill-to-minimum only, via source (below).

ref.description: book-section: the section id/title. capability-evidence: the crs-06 statement's capabilityId. named-theory-anchor: the lessonKey of the one existing book-grounded lesson this theory LO is anchored inside.

source.description: Required when layer=2: a Layer-1 book-section LO is self-evidently grounded by its own text and needs no separate source.

agentContext.fieldDescription: 4-6 flat LOs for this tier, book-first two-layer method. No course-outcome tier above them under this profile.

authoringReview.instruction: Build outcomes in two passes. Layer 1: for each real book-chapter section in this tier's bookGrounding window, write one LO stating the one verb/one object the section actually teaches; set layer=1, no source needed. Layer 2: only if Layer 1 produced fewer than 4, fill to the 4-6 range using the pathway's own applied evidence statement (crs-06, source.type=capability-evidence, source.ref=capabilityId) or at most one named-theory LO per tier anchored inside an existing book-grounded lesson (source.type=named-theory-anchor, source.ref=that lesson's key). validation.purpose: crs-07 is where the flat-6 ruling (2 Nov 2026) and the book-first two-layer method are enforced before the lesson map (crs-04) builds lessons on top of these LOs.

parameters.interactivityProposals: v5 (3 Nov 2026 - the full quota flagged at v4): up to 10 candidate non-question components across the 4 activity slots (activity-1..4), drawn from activity-patterns + palette - real per-slot variety for the human to choose from, not one pre-picked component per slot. interiorPattern.description: B2: chosen interior teaching pattern (or null for plain prose).

check.description: B4: formative check, three items (one per lesson outcome): item 1 general/shell-coupled (tests o1); item 2 context-coupled (tests o2); item 3 token-substitution (tests o3, shell body carrying {{context}}).

tokenMode.description: For a token-substitution item: generic -> {{context}} fixed to 'your subject'; cxp-fillable -> pack fills context.label, floor 'your subject'. Optional; meaningful only for token-substitution coupling.

activityProposals.description: v2/v3 lessons (one activity slot, no slot key): 3 candidate-component proposals, one confirmed - unchanged and still valid. v4 lessons (activity-1..4, one entry per slot, each confirmed): 4 entries - unchanged and still valid. v5 (3 Nov 2026 - the deliberately breaking step flagged at v4, additive only): where a lesson wants real per-slot variety, a slot may carry more than one candidate (up to 10 total across the 4 slots), each entry tagged with the slot it belongs to; exactly one entry per represented slot carries status:confirmed, the rest carry status:drafted as a visible record of alternatives considered and rejected - this is the gate's concrete form of 'lots of agent suggestion, human decides' for activities. slot stays optional (omitted on v2/v3's single, un-slotted set) and is required only once a v4/v5 per-slot shape is in use.

slot.description: v4/v5 only: which activity slot this proposal belongs to. Omitted on v2/v3's un-slotted single-set lessons. Required in practice once a lesson uses the v4/v5 per-slot shape, since without it multiple candidates for different slots are indistinguishable - enforced by ACT-1 (agentContext.validation), not the schema, so that v2/v3's un-slotted records stay untouched.

coupledSlots.description: Per-slot coupling marking: coupled + variationType (shell-coupled | token-substitution | structured-fields | whole-prose).

agentContext.fieldDescription: One consolidated per-lesson gate (A6.2): interior design (knowledge/interactivity, worked example, pacing, visuals) + activities (formative check, reflective prompt, up to 10 interactivity proposals across the 4 activity slots, one confirmed each) + per-slot coupling marking. validation.purpose: les-01 is where 'lots of agent suggestion, human decides' is meant to be concretely true for activities (owner ruling, 3 Nov 2026) - the v5 widened activityProposals shape only delivers that in practice if the agent actually proposes real per-slot variety and the confirm/amend response genuinely lets the human pick between distinct options, not a single foregone choice dressed as a proposal. These checks apply only to v4/v5 lessons (any entry carries a slot key); a v2/v3 lesson's un-slotted 3-candidates/1-confirmed set is a different, still-valid shape and is exempt from all three.

checks.rule: Not one of gate.md's numbered AL rules - a shape-intent check for the v5 widened quota, v4/v5 lessons only (skip entirely if no entry carries a slot key). Every one of activity-1/2/3/4 has exactly one activityProposals entry with status:confirmed, and no slot is left with zero entries.
checks.appliesTo: activityProposals[].slot against activityProposals[].status, grouped by slot

checks.rule: Not one of gate.md's numbered AL rules, v4/v5 lessons only (skip entirely if no entry carries a slot key). At least one slot (not necessarily all four, since a plain-prose or activity-mode-question slot may genuinely have only one defensible component) carries more than one proposal - i.e. the set as a whole shows real drafted-vs-confirmed variety, not four slots each holding a single pre-picked entry restyled as 'confirmed'. A lesson where every slot has exactly one entry has not actually used the v5 quota and should be revised before presenting.
checks.appliesTo: activityProposals.length against the per-slot entry counts (this draft)

checks.rule: Not one of gate.md's numbered AL rules, v4/v5 lessons only (skip entirely if no entry carries a slot key). Within a slot, every drafted (non-confirmed) proposal's component differs from every other proposal's component in that same slot - two identical component names in one slot is not a real alternative.

validation.scopeNote: ACT-1/ACT-2/ACT-3 are new labels introduced alongside the v5 activityProposals widening. Confirmed empirically (3 Nov 2026) against every closed les-01 record in the repo: 133 records carry a populated activityProposals, every one a v2/v3 un-slotted 3-candidates/1-confirmed set (0 entries anywhere carry a slot key), so ACT-1/2/3 are vacuously exempt on all of them today and there is nothing to reconcile retroactively; they bind only once a lesson actually adopts the v4/v5 per-slot shape.
validation.onFail: A failed check means the draft itself is wrong. Revise the draft proposals until every check passes before presenting - in particular, do not let a single-component-per-slot draft stand as if the human had a real choice.
